related_resources.reason: Collects the six-part story across Web of Spider-Man, Amazing Spider-Man and Spectacular Spider-Man.
First installment publication/credits. On-sale June 23 1987 versus October 1987 cover; creator retrospective says July.

First-person creation account: Wonder Man, Batman/Joker, Hugo Strange, Kraven, Dostoyevsky, Mary Jane, Mike Zeck, Salicrup and title. Retrospective memory, not independent proof of each private conversation.
Author specifically rejects honorable-suicide reading and explains why he wrote Soul of the Hunter. Long index page; find Soul of the Hunter in-page.

historical_claims.anchor: The six-part story ran in 1987 through three ongoing titles
Its writer was J. M. DeMatteis
It began with an idea for Wonder Man, the Marvel hero Simon Williams
historical_claims.source_locator: Creator retrospective original Wonder Man pitch

historical_claims.anchor: The detail that caught him was Kraven's Russian background
DeMatteis and Zeck had already worked together on *Captain America*
Salicrup proposed running the six installments through the three Spider-Man titles
Vermin was a villain DeMatteis and Zeck had earlier developed for *Captain America*
DeMatteis later said explicitly that he did not intend Kraven's death to be an honorable triumph

description: Examines A story that arrived by refusing to become another story; the man who confuses a costume with an argument; and A buried man with a life above ground.
